description: Offensive-security writeups, research notes and cheatsheets by Arman Abrahamyan - HackTheBox walkthroughs, Active Directory attack paths, web exploitation and privilege escalation.
author: Arman Abrahamyan
availability: Open to penetration testing internships & junior roles
hero_blurb: 16-year-old offensive security student focused on Active Directory, web exploitation and privilege escalation. I break things on purpose and write down exactly how - HackTheBox writeups, CTF walkthroughs and the cheatsheets I actually use.
footer_note: Built from scratch. No trackers, no cookies, no JavaScript frameworks.

proof.label: Open-source security tooling
proof.detail: AD attack paths · SSTI exploitation · privesc

projects.name: AD-Path-Finder
projects.summary: A mini-BloodHound: turns Active Directory rights into a weighted graph and runs Dijkstra from any user to Domain Admin, flagging Kerberoastable, AS-REP and DCSync quick wins.

projects.name: SSTI-Exploiter
projects.summary: Tells real template evaluation apart from reflection, fingerprints 11 template engines and builds engine-specific RCE payloads. Ships with a vulnerable Flask lab.

projects.name: Sentinel
projects.summary: Privilege-escalation engine: an offline GTFOBins/HackTricks rule engine ranks ready-to-run vectors, with an optional LLM layer that re-prioritises and chains findings.
